description: Six four-option MC questions in German with an answer key.
prompt: Use the fair-practice-questions skill. Schreibe 6 MC-Fragen mit je 4 Optionen (A-D) zu den OSI-Schichten und zu TCP vs. UDP für meine Netzwerke-Klausur. Gib danach einen Lösungsschlüssel. Als Markdown ausgeben, kein Widget.

assertions.desc: Six questions with four options each can be parsed.
The correct option is not systematically the longest or most detailed.
Correct answers are spread over at least 3 positions, none used more than 3 times.
Every distractor is on-topic and plausible for a partial learner (real misconceptions or adjacent concepts); no joke or off-topic options.
No question stem, option or visible hint reveals the answer to another question.
No distinctive word from a stem appears only in the correct option, and no stem agrees grammatically with only one option.
A separate answer-key section follows the questions.
